# source: installed authblk.sty (preprint bundle). \author[mark]{name} and
# \affil[mark]{text} build the one author list \maketitle sets: each mark its
# own or authblk's count of affiliations, the marked names apart by \Authsep,
# \Authand and \Authands as the document renews them, then 1em below each
# marked affiliation on its line; with no mark and two affiliations or fewer,
# each block of names above its affiliation. Its options and \Authfont and
# \Affilfont are not modelled.
body impl \author[1]{Ada Example}\affil[1]{Example Institute}\maketitle
body impl \author[1]{Ada Example}\author[2]{Bo Sample}\affil[1]{Example Institute}\affil[2]{Sample University}\maketitle
body impl \author{Ada Example}\affil{Example Institute}\author{Bo Sample}\affil{Sample University}\maketitle
